column18: CNN-STAN autoencoder converted to SNN with Akida MetaTF: 85% lower computational requirements, power decrease claimed, minimal capacity trade-off

SDNN hand detection on Loihi 2 matches GPU model accuracy; estimated dynamic power about 7 mW, no GPU power figure
Review of SNN object detection (151 papers); hardware energy, latency, memory trade-offs are only one of three findings
Survey of evolutionary computation for SNN weight learning and architecture search; not focused on efficiency comparison or sparsity
N:M supermasks (SLTH) vs LSQ on Folded ResNets: better when unstructured, worse at N:M; initial-weight noise improves accuracy
SATO temporal-parallel SNN accelerator: 20.7x speedup, 6.0x energy saving vs 8-bit Eyeriss; 4.6x, 3.1x vs SpinalFlow

Federated meta-learning learns a sparse global MRI model (LTH keyword), then grows personalised models; fewer parameters, lower communication, no figures
STDP-trained federated SNN for radar gestures with weight pruning; claims higher energy efficiency than BP and BPTT, no figures

LTH-inspired personalised FL: incrementally expands client subnetworks, outperforms recent PFL methods under heterogeneity; no efficiency metric
Path eXclusion pruning at initialization via NTK trace finds lottery tickets at high sparsity; claims substantial cost savings, no figures
First genetic algorithm search for strong lottery tickets without gradients; smaller, better subnetworks than gradient-based SOTA on small binary tasks
SNN hyperparameter tuning on FPGA: fast sigmoid lowers firing rate (SVHN); 48% lower latency for 2.88% accuracy loss
FPGA spiking ensemble: LSQ and pruning cut parameters to 30%, accuracy 97.04%; 334 us, estimated 157 uJ per inference
Optical spiking CNN: 1.6 W, 2.44 ms vs typical GPU CNNs 150-300 W, 1-5 ms; competitive accuracy on three benchmarks
Position paper on ANN and SNN history and perspective; no empirical comparison or efficiency data in abstract
Spiking lottery tickets plus MultiSp (patch, weight, activation sparsity) for spiking transformers: extreme sparsity with slight performance drop, no figures
Event-camera gait recognition SNN: comparable accuracy to RGB systems with unquantified higher computational efficiency; no ANN comparison figures
